g.text: Up one aisle, round the back, down the other:
both ways on the one street, a turn of 0.5.
K · Through to a back street
One tile wide, in off one street and out onto the
Two aisles up from the street, gathered along
the back into a third down to one way out.
the way cars drive, one way
a turn tighter than a car turns (0.45)
A tile is 60 px (12 m). A car 0.29 × 0.15, an aisle 0.22,
bays at 60° and 0.2 across. Bays are placed by test:
wholly on the lot, clear of every aisle and of each other.
